description: Chat with your documents and run AI agents privately, using any model.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-11: a real install of AnythingLLM 1.16.1, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 1 credential of its own, keeps it beside the app's data, and reuses it if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Asks on first open which model to use — a local one through Ollama, or a provider's API key, which it keeps in its data folder.
Single-user and open by default: anyone who can reach the address can use it until you turn on password protection in its settings.
Local Store does not grant the SYS_ADMIN capability upstream suggests for the browser AnythingLLM uses to read websites as documents; if adding a website fails, that is why.

config.content:
{
  "id": "anythingllm",
  "name": "AnythingLLM",
  "version": "1.16.1",
  "source": "https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm",
  "website": "https://anythingllm.com",
  "documentation": "https://docs.anythingllm.com/installation-docker/local-docker",
  "short_desc": "Chat with your documents and run AI agents privately, using any model.",
  "categories": [
    "Artificial Intelligence"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "form_fields": [
    {

    }
  ]
}
